name: Imose Yui
source:
Characteristics: loves kissing. She loves skinship. She immediately dozes off. Her weak point is her boobs. She also has another hole to be developed...?
Special skills: all sports.

Outside, she is clearly energetic. A little rebellious at home. (A reaction to that she had to be on her own).
She's jealous, but she hates that and she immediately becomes self-loathing.
Honestly, her true character is a honest, good girl.
She loves cute things like dogs, cats, and stuffed animals.
She's in the age when she can't be honest.

[Translated from [url=http://lovebitch.jp/imoto-tokku/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
